title: qcom-ptool board
description: The hardware of one board: its storage devices and their geometry, and the SoC part of the contents metadata. A platform pairs it with the flavors flashed onto it. A board may instead be self-contained: its storages then also carry their partition layout (as a flavor storage does) and its 'contents' is complete, so one file describes a whole configuration, e.g. out of tree.

contents.description: The SoC part of the contents metadata (chip, chipset, additional-chipids and the boot-chain firmware 'common' entries), which a platform's contents is laid over; in a self-contained board, complete contents validated against contents.schema.json.

id.description: Storage identifier, unique within the board; names the output directory.

grow-last-partition.description: Self-contained boards only; validated as a flavor storage.

includes.description: Self-contained boards only; validated as a flavor storage.

partitions.description: Self-contained boards only; validated as a flavor storage.

luns.description: Self-contained boards only; validated as a flavor storage.

phys-parts.description: Self-contained boards only; validated as a flavor storage.
